channel.title: Tri-Valley Dispatch
channel.description: Tri-Valley news, once a week, from the Tri-Valley Dispatch.

item.title: Pleasanton's Hometown Holiday parade fills Main Street on Saturday, December 5, at 5 PM
item.description: The parade is followed by a tree lighting in front of the Museum on Main and runs rain or shine.

item.title: Livermore shreds paper free this Saturday, November 21, from 8 to 11 AM, at a new spot: Las Positas College, Lot E
item.description: Livermore residents can bring up to three banker boxes of documents and stay in the car while they are shredded on site.

item.title: Dublin's Tassajara Road work is due to finish by December 1
item.description: Phase 1 of the Tassajara Road Improvements is on southbound Tassajara between North Dublin Ranch Drive and Quarry Lane; December 1 is the deadline in the project's regulatory permit.

item.title: San Ramon's council takes up a citywide traffic-signal plan on Tuesday, November 24, at 6:30 PM
item.description: The updated technology plan covers the city's 109 signals (the city runs 103, Caltrans six): better vehicle detection, more coordinated and adaptive signal timing, and accessible pedestrian signals.

item.title: a sandbag before the next storm
item.description: Three cities hand out sand and bags free, self-serve, and you bring your own shovel.
